findings.message: 19.P4.watchdog-activation requires expected/stuck budgets for every production call, including ticketless Author and triage. Those surfaces supply only AUTHOR_STUCK_S=900 and TRIAGE_STUCK_S=600, respectively; neither the cited contracts nor their inputs define an expected budget or its derivation. Detector.region requires that value to determine the expected-times-1.5 soft-warning boundary. Supplying one would invent governing behavior.
findings.paved_road: Define ticketless expected budgets, their derivation, or explicit implementer discretion in 19.P4.watchdog-activation, while preserving the existing stuck limits, then regenerate the activation ticket.
